title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 46
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 46: the east gate on Sabbaths and new moons, the offerings of the prince, and the boiling houses in the corners of the court.

questions.text: When is the east gate of the inner court shut, and when is it opened?
questions.explanation: The gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shall be shut the six working days, but on the Sabbath day and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

answers.text: Opened every day of the week at dawn
Shut six working days, opened on Sabbath and new moon
Shut on the Sabbath, opened on work days
Opened only at the Passover feast

questions.text: Where does the prince worship, after the priests prepare his offerings?
questions.explanation: The prince shall stand by the post of the gate and worship at the threshold of the gate, and then go out.

answers.text: In the most holy place
At the altar in the inner court
Outside the wall of the outer court
At the threshold of the gate

questions.text: Until when shall that gate not be shut, after the prince goes out?
questions.explanation: He shall go out, but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

answers.text: Until the evening
Until the morning
Until the new moon
Until the prince returns

questions.text: Where do the people of the land worship on the Sabbaths and the new moons?
questions.explanation: The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before Yahweh on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.

answers.text: In the inner court by the altar
In the holy rooms of the priests
At the door of that gate
On the pavement of the outer court

questions.text: What burnt offering shall the prince offer on the Sabbath day?
questions.explanation: On the Sabbath day the burnt offering shall be six lambs without defect and a ram without defect.

answers.text: A young bull and two rams
Seven bulls and seven rams
One lamb a year old
Six lambs and a ram, without defect

questions.text: What shall be offered on the day of the new moon?
questions.explanation: On the day of the new moon it shall be a young bull without defect, and six lambs, and a ram, all without defect.

answers.text: A young bull, six lambs, and a ram
Six lambs and a ram only
Two bulls and two rams
A male goat and one lamb

questions.text: How must the people of the land leave when they come before Yahweh in the appointed feasts?
questions.explanation: He who enters by the way of the north gate shall go out by the south gate, and he who enters by the south gate shall go out by the north gate, not returning by the gate he came in.

answers.text: By the same gate they came in
All of them by the east gate
By the gate opposite the one they entered
By the way of the porch of the house

questions.text: What shall be prepared for a burnt offering to Yahweh morning by morning?
questions.explanation: A lamb a year old without defect shall be prepared for a burnt offering to Yahweh daily, morning by morning.

answers.text: A young bull without defect
A lamb a year old without defect
Six lambs and a ram
A male goat for a sin offering

questions.text: If the prince gives part of his inheritance to one of his servants, how long is it the servant's?
questions.explanation: If he gives of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty, and then it shall return to the prince.

answers.text: Until the year of liberty
Forever, as for his sons
For seven years only
Until the next new moon

questions.text: What were the measurements of the enclosed courts in the four corners of the court?
questions.explanation: In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed, forty cubits long and thirty wide, and these four were the same size.

answers.text: Fifty cubits long and twenty-five wide
One hundred cubits square
Forty cubits long and thirty wide
Twenty cubits long and eleven wide
